result.finding: Assessed 5 CWE rules in Credentials & Secrets: 0 FOUND, 5 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Read-only security specialist source/configuration assessment and follow-up default reachability reassessment; no credential contents printed, no source modified or tests run.

src/main/java/com/photoalbum/config/SecurityConfig.java:29-42: BCrypt encodes externally supplied administrator passwords; app.admin.password at line 37 has no fallback. No embedded operational password or cryptographic key identified.

docker-compose.yml:7,9,34,36: all password substitutions use required-if-unset syntax, with no literal fallback. src/main/resources/application.properties:14 and application-docker.properties:5 use SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD without a default.
oracle-init/create-user.sh:11,13 reject missing ORACLE_PASSWORD/APP_USER_PASSWORD; lines 22,30 consume only supplied variables.
azure-setup.ps1:39,41 chooses supplied environment passwords or New-StrongPassword; lines 15-22 use a cryptographic RNG, not a constant fallback.

.env.example:6,12,17 contain explicit replacement placeholders [REDACTED]; lines 1-3 instruct copying and replacing them. No .env exists in the inspected workspace; .env.example is not automatically loaded by Compose/application. Manually copying without replacing could cause dummy values to be consumed, but no hard-coded runnable application default was found, including development configuration. Usernames alone were not classified as passwords. This determination is based on configuration syntax, not availability of deployed credentials.

src/main/java/com/photoalbum/config/SecurityConfig.java:19-23,55-60: public read-only gallery access is intentional; upload/delete POST endpoints require authentication. oracle-init/01-create-user.sql:16-30 grants schema-scoped privileges, not DBA/system-wide ANY permissions. No demonstrated critical-resource permission assignment to unintended actors identified.

src/main/java/com/photoalbum/service/impl/PhotoServiceImpl.java:91-102,179-189,203-216 and src/main/java/com/photoalbum/controller/DetailController.java:69-75 log upload rejection/success/failure and deletion outcomes with resource identifiers. Mutation logs omit explicit principal/client address; single configured admin limits actor ambiguity. No custom authentication audit handler identified; framework/deployment authentication logging and complete audit coverage were not runtime verified. No confirmed omission of a required event/detail was established; NOT_FOUND is not an assertion of complete audit coverage.

Initial findings CWE-319 (plain HTTP Basic credential transport at the direct default endpoint) and CWE-352 (disabled CSRF with browser Basic authentication) are separate rule IDs outside these six requested categories, not evidence of hard-coded passwords, keys, credentials, or unintended permissions.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Password
values.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
values.description: The product uses a hard-coded, unchangeable cryptographic key.

values.name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
values.description: The product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows that resource to be read or modified by unintended actors.

values.name: Insufficient Logging
values.description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
values.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.
